"""Unit/prefix projections for traffic masses and arbitrary active masks.

The kernels here are the building blocks of the path worker.  Arrays store
traffic *amounts* (not fractions), therefore every projection accepts an
explicit per-commodity `mass` vector and an `active` mask describing which
slots may carry traffic at all.  Columns without any active slot and columns
with a non-positive mass collapse to the zero vector, which used to produce
`nan`/`inf` in the historical implementation.
"""
import numpy as np
from typing import Optional

from array_utils.cpu.types import cpu_cast_float

# Slots that are inactive are pushed far below any feasible dual threshold.
# Traffic amounts are bounded by 1e9 in this protocol, so this sentinel can
# never be selected as part of a projection while staying clear of overflow.
_INACTIVE = -1e21


def _masked_values(x: np.ndarray, active: Optional[np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
    """Copy `x` with inactive entries replaced by the sentinel value."""
    if active is None:
        return np.array(x, dtype=np.float64, copy=True)
    return np.where(active, x, _INACTIVE)


def simplex_projection_columns(values: np.ndarray, mass: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Project every column of `values` onto `{y >= 0 : sum(y) == mass}`.

    `values` has shape `(T, K)`, `mass` has shape `(K,)`.  Columns whose mass
    is not strictly positive project to zero; columns whose entries are all
    sentinel values project to zero as well.
    """
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
    mass = np.asarray(mass, dtype=np.float64)
    T, K = values.shape
    out = np.zeros((T, K), dtype=np.float64)
    if K == 0 or T == 0:
        return out
    good = (mass > 0.0) & np.isfinite(values).all(axis=0)
    if not np.any(good):
        return out
    sub = values[:, good]
    m = mass[good]
    # Shift by the column maximum: this keeps the prefix sums well conditioned
    # without changing the argmax structure of the projection.
    shift = np.max(sub, axis=0)
    shifted = sub - shift
    order = np.argsort(-shifted, axis=0, kind='stable')
    ranked = np.take_along_axis(shifted, order, axis=0)
    prefix = np.cumsum(ranked, axis=0)
    count = np.arange(1, T + 1, dtype=np.float64)[:, np.newaxis]
    keep = ranked * count > (prefix - m[np.newaxis, :])
    # Every column with a positive mass has at least one `keep` entry (the
    # largest one), so `np.sum(keep) >= 1` and the index below is valid.
    rho = np.sum(keep, axis=0) - 1
    cols = np.arange(rho.shape[0])
    theta = (prefix[rho, cols] - m) / cpu_cast_float(rho + 1.0)
    projected = np.maximum(sub - theta[np.newaxis, :], 0.0)
    out[:, good] = projected
    return out


def orthant_projection_columns(values: np.ndarray, mass: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Project every column onto `{y >= 0 : sum(y) <= mass}` (the orthant volume)."""
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
    mass = np.asarray(mass, dtype=np.float64)
    out = np.maximum(values, 0.0)
    total = out.sum(axis=0)
    over = (mass > 0.0) & (total > mass)
    if not np.any(over):
        return out
    out[:, over] = simplex_projection_columns(out[:, over], mass[over])
    return out


def project_onto_probability_simplex(x: np.ndarray, pinned: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
                                     mass=None, active=None) -> np.ndarray:
    """Project each column of `x` onto a (possibly pinned) probability simplex.

    `mass` generalises the unit mass, `active` is a full Boolean mask of the
    same shape as `x`.  `pinned` is kept for backwards compatibility: entries
    at or beyond `pinned[i]` are excluded from the projection.
    """
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    if x.ndim == 1:
        x = x[:, np.newaxis]
        single = True
    else:
        single = False
    N, M = x.shape
    if active is None:
        active = np.ones((N, M), dtype=bool)
    else:
        active = np.asarray(active, dtype=bool)
        if active.shape != (N, M):
            active = np.broadcast_to(active, (N, M))
    if pinned is not None:
        pin = np.asarray(pinned)
        mask = np.arange(N)[:, np.newaxis] >= pin
        active = active & (~mask)
    if mass is None:
        mass = np.ones(M, dtype=np.float64)
    else:
        mass = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(mass, dtype=np.float64), (M,))
    values = _masked_values(x, active)
    out = simplex_projection_columns(values, mass)
    out = np.where(active, out, 0.0)
    return out[:, 0] if single else out


def project_onto_probability_orthant(x: np.ndarray, pinned: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
                                     mass=None, active=None) -> np.ndarray:
    """Project onto the orthant volume `{0 <= y <= mass * 1}` column-wise."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    if x.ndim == 1:
        x = x[:, np.newaxis]
        single = True
    else:
        single = False
    N, M = x.shape
    if active is None:
        active = np.ones((N, M), dtype=bool)
    else:
        active = np.asarray(active, dtype=bool)
    if pinned is not None:
        pin = np.asarray(pinned)
        active = active & ~(np.arange(N)[:, np.newaxis] >= pin)
    if mass is None:
        mass = np.ones(M, dtype=np.float64)
    else:
        mass = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(mass, dtype=np.float64), (M,))
    values = np.where(active, x, 0.0)
    out = orthant_projection_columns(values, mass)
    out = np.where(active, out, 0.0)
    return out[:, 0] if single else out
